title: Hoelder absorption: |E/t^(n+1)/(1 + I/t^n)| <= 2 kappa Lambda R^(-1) (t/R)^(-n/p)
statement: Let n >= 1 be a natural number and p, R, Lambda, eps, t, I, E, N real numbers. Assume n < p, R > 0, Lambda > 0, 0 < eps <= 1, t > 0, I >= 0 and N >= 0. Write kappa := (p - n)/(4p). Assume N <= kappa Lambda R^(n/p - 1) and |E| <= (1 + eps) t N I^(1 - 1/p), with real powers. Then |E / t^(n+1) / (1 + I/t^n)| <= 2 kappa Lambda R^(-1) (t/R)^(-n/p). Here t^(n+1) and t^n are natural-number powers and (t/R)^(-n/p) is a real power.
